text:
Ayesha Khan: Quick heads up 1 I'm planning to start parental leave on Nov 3 for ~14 weeks. Two quick asks: is there a short-term childcare stipend for the first 8 weeks, and what's the recommended on-call handover for my rotation?

people-ops-bot: Hi Ayesha! See the parental leave resources here: https://intranet.redwood/people/parental-benefits. There's a Backup Care subsidy for eligible folks. Please submit the parental intake form to begin.

Marco Ruiz: @Ayesha we offer a Backup Care subsidy up to $1,200/mo for licensed childcare or vetted backup sitters. Policy requires intake form + receipts. You can request retroactive approval within 60 days if needed.

Lena Cho: On-call: can you list the top 3 runbook pages and the current paging escalation? I can cover weeks 2 and 6 if that helps. Also create a short "what I watch for" note for alerts that typically fire in the afternoon.

Ayesha Khan: Thanks @Lena. Top pages: CICD failures, realtime-retry, and model-serve-oom. I'll draft the 1-pager and tag owners.

Ben Foster: Payroll processing for reimbursements is 7-10 business days after submission. Reimbursements are non-taxable if they meet the qualified care definition and you upload receipts under HR portal > Reimbursements > Parental Backup Care.

Marco Ruiz: Also, if you anticipate signing approvals while away, add alternate approvers in the approvals tool. For vendor contracts > $15k, we need an exec-level sign-off.

Ayesha Khan: Good call. I'll add alternate signers for low-value approvals and route anything high-value to Marco.

IT-helpdesk: Quick note: if you're traveling internationally during leave and plan to access company systems, file a short IT travel/Security exception. Otherwise we recommend using company laptop + standard VPN auth.

Lena Cho: I'll take the weekly syncs weeks 1-4, and Ben can handle urgent payroll questions. Marco, can you be backup for any contract questions?

Marco Ruiz: Yep happy to. If anyone else picks up docs or PRs, please add owners in the PR description and pin a sibling task in Jira.

Ayesha Khan: Filling out the intake this afternoon and will drop confirmation here. Appreciate the coverage! :heart:
